page_title: RMA 4-1 ESP | Real Madrid v Espanyol 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Jose Luis Munuera Montero has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+3' Endrick (Real Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' 4 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) slams home the penalty with a precise shot which goes inside the right post.
89' Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Real Madrid!
89' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Real Madrid as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
89' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
88' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
88' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball. The referee points to the spot and a penalty is about to be taken!
86' 26:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) coming on for Jude Bellingham.
84' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Rodrygo is replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Espanyol comes to nothing.
82' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) disagrees with the decision of the referee and is given a yellow card.
81' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Jose Luis Munuera Montero's book.
81' The percentage of ball possession is – 73:27.
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Pere Milla (Espanyol) for Javi Puado.
78' 3 - 1 Goal - 3:1! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a precise pass inside the box from Kylian Mbappe and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the bottom right corner.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jofre leaves the pitch and Irvin Cardona (Espanyol) comes on.
76' Manolo Gonzalez decides to make a substitution. Alvaro Tejero will be replaced by Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol).
75' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Vinicius Junior laid the ball off to Rodrygo (Real Madrid), who unleashed a strong shot from close range into the back of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
74' Jose Luis Munuera Montero rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Joan Garcia (Espanyol).

74' A rebound falls to Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
72' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
71' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the bottom left corner lacks power and Joan Garcia easily makes the save.
70' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) whips in a cross from the corner, but Joan Garcia is well positioned and punches the ball away.
68' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
67' Today's match ends for Pol Lozano who will be replaced by Jose Gragera (Espanyol).
65' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) commits a rough challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for an infringement.

64' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
63' It looks like Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Jose Luis Munuera Montero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
62' The resulting set piece from Espanyol is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
61' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play. Espanyol are awarded a corner kick.
61' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
60' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Daniel Carvajal.
58' 1 - 1 The attempt by Jude Bellingham is blocked but, from the middle of the box Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) hits the rebound into the centre of the goal. He alters the score to 1:1.
58' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Luka Modric (Real Madrid). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
58' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.
55' Substitution. Arda Guler will be replaced by Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
54' 0 - 1 Own goal! Thibaut Courtois (Real Madrid) suffers a good deal of misfortune as he accidentally puts a pass from one of the attacking players into his own net. The score is 0:1.
51' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.

51' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rodrygo (Real Madrid). Real Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

50' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Joan Garcia has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.

48' That was close by Carlos Romero (Espanyol)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
48' Espanyol can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
47' Alvaro Tejero (Espanyol) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked. Espanyol get a corner.
46' Excellent touch by Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a terrific save.
46' Walid Cheddira goes off the pitch and Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) comes on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) whips the ball into the box and Kylian Mbappe takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
45+1' The corner kick from Carlos Romero (Espanyol) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jofre (Espanyol) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Espanyol will take a corner kick.
44' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
41' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

40' A short pass finds Javi Puado (Espanyol). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
39' Javi Puado (Espanyol) hammers the ball from far out, but it goes narrowly over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.

37' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Joan Garcia is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
36' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Luka Modric (Real Madrid).

35' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.

33' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
32' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Jose Luis Munuera Montero lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
31' Real Madrid are ruled offside.
30' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) leaps like a salmon and plants a great close-range header from the corner towards goal, but the effort is blocked at the last moment.
30' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
30' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Real Madrid have a corner.
29' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
27' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick, but Joan Garcia reads it well and stops the effort.
26' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
25' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero who sees an offensive foul.
23' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.

21' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) beats a couple of players and hammers in a low shot from mid-range towards the middle of the goal. The keeper is caught unaware but still pulls off a great save to deny the effort.

19' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Joan Garcia, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
18' The Real Madrid players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
16' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
15' Good clearance! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
14' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Joan Garcia.

11' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.
11' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner.
11' Great save! Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the left side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Joan Garcia.
10' Yellow card. Pol Lozano (Espanyol) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
8' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
7' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
7' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
7' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
7' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Luka Modric (Real Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Madrid.
4' Half-chance! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Joan Garcia reacts well to snuff out the attack.
2' The ball is cleared after Javi Puado (Espanyol) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Jose Luis Munuera Montero.
